units: B. Kam. 62ᵃ (defining the difference between the ח׳ and the גַּזְלָן) ח׳ יהיב וכ׳ the ḥamsan takes by force and pays.—Pl. חַמְסָנִים, חַמְסָנִין.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:11">Snh. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>הוסיפו עליהן … והח׳</he> (Ar. <he>והחוֹ׳</he>) they added to them (the class of persons disqualified for judges or witnesses) the robbers and those taking forcibly (and paying); Y. Shebu. VII, 37ᵈ bot.; Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᶜ top.
